question: 6061-T6 铝合金导热系数的合理波动区间下限为 167 W/(m·K)，主要受加工硬化状态和微量元素杂质含量影响。

sources.title: Thermal Conductivity of Aluminum 6061: A Detailed Report
sources.snippet: The thermal conductivity of aluminum 6061 is 167 W/ (m·K) in the T6 temper at 25°C. This is the value you will find in the ASM Handbook and the Aluminum Association design data, and it is the correct value to use for heat transfer calculations involving 6061-T6 sheet, plate, extrusions, and machined components.
